<!-- Pull requests go into `dev`, not `main` (see CONTRIBUTING.md). -->

**What and why:**

- [ ] Base branch is `dev`
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing; `go vet ./...` and `go test -race ./...` pass
- [ ] Documentation in `docs/` updated (or not needed)
- [ ] Line in `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased" (or nothing users notice)
